As Culver City celebrates Independence Day on Saturday, July 5th, please be advised of the following road closures and traffic impacts:
 
🚧 𝟰:𝟬𝟬 𝗣𝗠 – 𝟭𝟬:𝟬𝟬 𝗣𝗠
A section of Main Street will be closed between Culver Boulevard and Venice Boulevard for event activities.

🚦 𝟵:𝟬𝟬 𝗣𝗠 – 𝟵:𝟭𝟱 𝗣𝗠
Expect a temporary pause in traffic on Ince Boulevard, from Washington Boulevard to Krueger Street, for the duration of the drone show.
 
🚗 🚶‍♀️𝟵:𝟯𝟬 𝗣𝗠 – 𝟭𝟬:𝟯𝟬 𝗣𝗠
Anticipate heavy vehicle and pedestrian traffic as eventgoers exit the area.
 
We encourage attendees and commuters to plan ahead, use alternate routes, and allow extra travel time. Thank you for helping us celebrate safely!

For more information about the event, please visit ➡️ https://t.co/tdfFiosylt

For questions regarding road closures, please contact the Culver City Police Department Public Information Officer Jennifer Atenza at (310) 253-6120 or email jennifer.atenza@culvercity.org.
